items.title: OTS Starter Image
items.description: Bootstrap a fresh install to a working digital twin: the full NYSE+NASDAQ Opportunity Surface (universe, precision-weighted model values, 26 recorded heat-map days through 2026-07-28), FIFTEEN strategic-initiative books — TSLA, the Tranche-1 six (PLTR, LITE, BE, RVMD, CRDO, RKLB), CAT and CSCO, the memory/HBM names (MU, STX, WDC, SNDK), and SPCX — every number journaled as authored judgment, with the private-name reference inputs those books need to be expressed per share, the owner valuation-structure classifications, and workspace configuration (cohorts, alerts, tuning registry, alert subscriptions). Contains NO keys, NO portfolios, NO personal research. Imported records carry origin provenance; your own history stays yours.
items.author: Open Trading Surface (reference instance)
items.notes: Free. v1.1.0 — reference surface through 2026-07-28 on plugin 4.3.2. FIRST image whose pack coverage is proven from the source rather than curated: every state store now has a pack decision and the manifest reports none skipped. Adds the eight books written since 1.0.0 (SPCX among them) plus reference-inputs.json, without which a private-name book arrives with no share count to express it per share and reads as absent. v1.0.0 remains installable. Descriptive market data and authored judgment made explicit — not investment advice.
